$comment: External apps embedded on the desktop. `source` is a path to the app's local checkout, relative to this repo's root. `scripts/sync-apps.mjs` builds each app and vendors its static output into public/apps/<id>/ (committed) so Netlify can serve it without ever seeing the app's source. After adding an entry here, also add the matching `embed` entry to src/apps/registry.tsx and an icon under public/img/apps/.
